sources.title: bloomz-560m · Models
sources.snippet: For BLOOMZ models, we recommend making it very clear when the input stops to avoid the model trying to continue it. For example, the prompt " Translate to English: Je t'aime " without the full stop (.) at the end, may result in the model trying to continue the French sentence.
